blocks.head: alt ClientX is authenticated and does not know a context identifier
alt ClientY is authenticated, knows no context identifier, and a context Ctx exists
alt ClientY is authenticated and knows context identifier Ctx
alt ClientX is authenticated and knows context identifier Ctx

state_rules.rule:
eq < serverA | ('contexts' : nils , ..) > $ ClientX 'sendWithoutContext' serverA | ('msgA') 
= < serverA | ('contexts' : ('id' : 'ctxX' , 'history' : ('msgA') , ..) , ..) > $ serverA 'returnInitialContext' ClientX | ('ctxX' ; ('msgA')) .

eq < ClientX | ('knowCtx' : nils , 'receivedHistory' : nils , ..) > $ serverA 'returnInitialContext' ClientX | (Ctx ; Hist) 
= < ClientX | ('knowCtx' : Ctx , 'receivedHistory' : Hist , ..) > .

ceq < ClientX | ('knowCtx' : Ctx , 'receivedHistory' : OldHist , ..) > $ serverA 'returnInitialContext' ClientX | (ReturnedCtx ; Hist) 
= < ClientX | ('knowCtx' : Ctx , 'receivedHistory' : Hist , ..) > if Ctx =/= nils .

ceq < ClientX | ('knowCtx' : nils , 'receivedHistory' : OldHist , ..) > $ serverA 'returnInitialContext' ClientX | (Ctx ; Hist) 
= < ClientX | ('knowCtx' : nils , 'receivedHistory' : Hist , ..) > if OldHist =/= nils .

eq < ClientY | ('authenticated' : true , 'knowCtx' : OldCtx , ..) > < serverA | ('contexts' : ('id' : Ctx , 'history' : Hist , ...) , ....) > $ ClientY 'snoop' serverA | (Ctx) 
= < ClientY | ('authenticated' : true , 'knowCtx' : Ctx , ..) > < serverA | ('contexts' : ('id' : Ctx , 'history' : Hist , ...) , ....) > .

eq < serverA | ('contexts' : ('id' : Ctx , 'history' : Hist , ..) , ...) > $ ClientY 'sendWithContext' serverA | (Ctx ; 'msgB') 
= < serverA | ('contexts' : ('id' : Ctx , 'history' : ('msgB' , Hist) , ..) , ...) > $ serverA 'returnHistory' ClientY | (Ctx ; ('msgB' , Hist)) .

eq < ClientY | ('receivedHistory' : OldHist , ..) > $ serverA 'returnHistory' ClientY | (Ctx ; Hist) 
= < ClientY | ('receivedHistory' : Hist , ..) > .

eq < serverA | ('contexts' : ('id' : Ctx , 'history' : Hist , ..) , ...) > $ ClientX 'sendWithContext' serverA | (Ctx ; 'msgA2') 
= < serverA | ('contexts' : ('id' : Ctx , 'history' : ('msgA2' , Hist) , ..) , ...) > $ serverA 'returnHistory' ClientX | (Ctx ; ('msgA2' , Hist)) .

eq < ClientX | ('receivedHistory' : OldHist , ..) > $ serverA 'returnHistory' ClientX | (Ctx ; Hist) 
= < ClientX | ('receivedHistory' : Hist , ..) > .

event_rules.label: rev1
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev1]: E @ S < ClientX | ('authenticated' : true , 'knowCtx' : nils , ..) > 
=> ep: ev1(ClientX) @ S < ClientX | ('authenticated' : true , 'knowCtx' : nils , ..) > .

event_rules.label: rev2
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev2]: E @ S < ClientY | ('authenticated' : true , 'knowCtx' : nils , ..) > < serverA | ('contexts' : ('id' : Ctx , ...) , ....) > 
=> ep: ev2(ClientY, Ctx) @ S < ClientY | ('authenticated' : true , 'knowCtx' : nils , ..) > < serverA | ('contexts' : ('id' : Ctx , ...) , ....) > .

event_rules.label: rev3
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev3]: E @ S < ClientY | ('authenticated' : true , 'knowCtx' : (Ctx , Rest) , ..) > 
=> ep: ev3(ClientY, Ctx) @ S < ClientY | ('authenticated' : true , 'knowCtx' : (Ctx , Rest) , ..) > .

event_rules.label: rev4
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev4]: E @ S < ClientX | ('authenticated' : true , 'knowCtx' : (Ctx , Rest) , ..) > 
=> ep: ev4(ClientX, Ctx) @ S < ClientX | ('authenticated' : true , 'knowCtx' : (Ctx , Rest) , ..) > .
